value.rationale: The natural commuting relation of algebra retracts gives a nontrivial structural invariant for all finite-field nonsingular rank-one-square evolution algebras. Its exact edge formula distinguishes opposite nonzero norm classes in every odd dimension despite identical projection counts; q^(5(n-3)/2) measures the discrete gap. This is a meaningful classification and geometric compatibility result, not merely calculating old singular-point tables.
